passages.title: Analytical Exposition: Claims and Evidence
passages.text: A student article argues that schools should provide refillable water stations. Students who forget a bottle could still reach drinking water, and reusable bottles may reduce single-use plastic. To support the proposal, the writer describes a survey in two classes in which most respondents wanted easier water access. However, the article acknowledges that two classes do not represent the whole school. It recommends a short trial and a wider survey before the principal decides whether to install more stations.
